title: Juicy Turkish Chorizo Su Boregi
description: A peppery and shattering Turkish dish featuring chorizo in a flaky pastry, perfect for crowds, this su boregi is a low-fat friendly option that is sure to please, with a form that is both beautiful and delicious.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the phyllo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
In a bowl, mix together the chorizo, feta cheese, eggs, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Place a quarter of the chorizo mixture onto the center of each phyllo piece.
Brush the edges of the phyllo with olive oil and fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle.
Brush the tops of the su boregi with olive oil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the su boregi from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the su boregi warm and enjoy.
